item.title: KelpDAO loses $292M to cross-chain bridge exploit via LayerZero; Lazarus Group attributed as attacker.
Drift Protocol drained of $285M in separate Lazarus Group-linked breach, 2026's second-largest DeFi exploit.
U.S. Senate departs for recess without CLARITY Act vote; Democrats blocked floor action over ethics provision.
Coldcard hardware wallet exploit drains approximately $114M in bitcoin, raising scrutiny of institutional cold-storage.
JPMorgan boosts BlackRock IBIT stake to $356M in Q2 2026 13F filing, up from $162M in Q1; ETH ETF position quadruples.
Morgan Stanley holds 16.5M IBIT shares at Q2 2026 close, up from 13.4M in Q1, per 13F SEC filing.
Japan's Travel Rule for crypto exchanges and payment service providers took effect August 3, requiring transfer-level data.
SEC issues no-action letter to DTC permitting tokenization of ETFs and U.S. Treasury securities held in custody.
UK FCA set to open crypto asset firm licensing applications in September 2026 under new regulatory framework.
EU Commission's MiCA review consultation closes August 31; responses to weigh expanded stablecoin and DeFi coverage.
DeFi exploits exceeded $840M in first five months of 2026; Chainalysis attributes 76% of crypto hack losses to Lazarus Group.
Citi plans to launch crypto custody services in 2026, expanding institutional digital asset offerings per CNBC report.
EU MiCA full compliance enforcement began July 1; unlicensed exchanges must cease offering services to EU clients.
SEC and CFTC signed crypto coordination MOU committing both agencies to harmonize digital asset classification and enforcement.
